search_denominator: All ten candidates below remain in the campaign denominator regardless of rejection, blocking, or later execution availability.

canonical_data.source_class: Research Data Spine V0; first-party Binance USD-M 1h OHLCV certificate
canonical_data.panel: The exact certified 20-symbol panel, fixed before outcomes; no result-conditioned substitutions.
canonical_data.coverage: Use only the certified snapshot coverage and a deterministic common complete-row policy; exact final dates are fixed in the finalist contracts.

candidates.short_name: Market volatility state adds to HAR RV
candidates.mechanism: Volatility clustering makes current market-wide dispersion state informative about near-future market volatility.
candidates.feature: MARKET_RV24_t = sqrt(sum of the prior 24 hourly BTCUSDT log-return squares), using the completed bar at t.
candidates.outcome: BTC_RV24_future_t = sqrt(sum of the next 24 hourly BTCUSDT log-return squares).
candidates.decision_time: After the completed hourly bar at t.
candidates.universe_panel: BTCUSDT perpetual from the certified panel.
candidates.baseline: Intercept plus fixed HAR terms RV24_t, RV168_t, and RV720_t; feature tests incremental value beyond persistence.
candidates.incremental_information_question: Does the single current 24h market-volatility state add information beyond the frozen HAR persistence baseline?
candidates.likely_canonical_source: Research Data Spine V0 BTCUSDT partition
candidates.pit_feasibility: Explicit completed-bar cutoff; safe-known-after is bar close.
candidates.likely_historical_sample: Approximately four years of hourly origins after 720h warmup.
candidates.shadow_deployability: One scalar prediction record per hourly origin; no redesign required.
candidates.relation_to_existing_jigsaw: INCREMENTAL_INFORMATION_TEST; JH01 RV persistence is related and must be named, not laundered as new.
candidates.relation_to_prior_failed_candidates: Not a rescue of JFP03 AFI; no volume denominator.
obvious_confounders: volatility persistence is the intended baseline
candidates.strongest_falsifier: The incremental coefficient fails direction or materiality after the fixed HAR adjustment.

candidates.short_name: Breadth state adds to market return forecast
candidates.mechanism: A market-wide participation state may distinguish broad moves from narrow moves and add information about the next market return.
candidates.feature: BREADTH_t = mean over the fixed 20-symbol panel of sign(log-return over the completed hour ending at t).
candidates.decision_time: After all fixed-panel bars ending at t are complete.
candidates.universe_panel: Fixed certified 20-symbol panel; BTCUSDT is the outcome instrument.
candidates.baseline: Intercept plus BTCUSDT prior 24h return; no strategy or PnL benchmark.
candidates.incremental_information_question: Does breadth add information beyond the focal asset's own recent return?
candidates.likely_canonical_source: Research Data Spine V0 fixed 20-symbol partitions
candidates.pit_feasibility: All inputs are completed at t; outcome begins strictly after t.
candidates.likely_historical_sample: Approximately four years of hourly origins after 24h warmup and 24h tail.
candidates.shadow_deployability: Fixed panel state and one return forecast can be persisted prospectively.
candidates.relation_to_existing_jigsaw: DISTINCT_OUTCOME; JH03 breadth-to-return is related evidence and this is an explicitly different incremental baseline and horizon.
candidates.relation_to_prior_failed_candidates: Not a rescue of Breadth V2 strategy variants; no parameter sweep.
candidates.strongest_falsifier: Breadth adds no fixed-baseline information or effect is immaterial.

candidates.mechanism: A wide cross-sectional return distribution may signal heterogeneous positioning and subsequent aggregate volatility.
candidates.feature: CS_DISPERSION_t = cross-sectional standard deviation of the 20 completed one-hour log returns at t.
candidates.decision_time: After the completed panel hour at t.
candidates.universe_panel: Fixed certified 20-symbol panel; BTCUSDT future volatility is the outcome.
candidates.baseline: Intercept plus BTCUSDT RV24_t; no HAR terms, to keep the incremental question singular and identifiable.
candidates.incremental_information_question: Does contemporaneous cross-sectional dispersion add information beyond focal-asset volatility?
candidates.likely_canonical_source: Research Data Spine V0 fixed 20-symbol partitions
candidates.pit_feasibility: Completed panel bar only; future bars are excluded from feature construction.
candidates.likely_historical_sample: Approximately four years of hourly origins after 24h tail.
candidates.shadow_deployability: One panel statistic and one forecast artifact per hour.
candidates.relation_to_existing_jigsaw: CONDITIONAL_EXTENSION; existing JH02 dispersion-to-RV evidence used a different dispersion definition/context and is explicitly prior exposure.
candidates.relation_to_prior_failed_candidates: Not a rescue of the prior cross-sectional-dispersion strategy result; different outcome role and fixed panel test.
candidates.strongest_falsifier: No incremental association after fixed focal volatility control.

candidates.mechanism: When panel movement is concentrated in a few instruments, the cross-sectional state may transition toward continued heterogeneity.
candidates.feature: RETURN_CONCENTRATION_t = max_i(abs(r_i,t)) / sum_i(abs(r_i,t)); defined only when the denominator is positive.
candidates.outcome: CS_DISPERSION_{t+24h}, the cross-sectional standard deviation of panel returns in the hour 24h after t.
candidates.decision_time: After the completed panel hour at t.
candidates.incremental_information_question: Does concentration add information about future dispersion beyond current dispersion?
candidates.likely_canonical_source: Research Data Spine V0 fixed 20-symbol partitions
candidates.pit_feasibility: Positive-denominator rule and completed-hour cutoff are explicit.
candidates.likely_historical_sample: Approximately four years minus 24h warmup/tail; blocked rows are not silently dropped.
candidates.shadow_deployability: A single bounded ratio with explicit zero-denominator blocking.
candidates.relation_to_existing_jigsaw: NEW_PROPOSITION; adjacent to dispersion pieces but not a duplicate feature/outcome relation.
candidates.relation_to_prior_failed_candidates: No known prior frozen candidate with this concentration definition.
candidates.strongest_falsifier: Denominator failure is frequent or concentration adds no information beyond dispersion.

candidates.mechanism: The same aggregate return state may carry different information when participation is broad versus narrow.
candidates.feature: VOL_BREADTH_INTERACTION_t = RV24_t * BREADTH_t, with RV24 and BREADTH defined exactly as above.
candidates.decision_time: After completed panel hour at t.
candidates.baseline: Intercept plus BTCUSDT prior 24h return, RV24_t, and BREADTH_t; one fixed interaction term only.
candidates.incremental_information_question: Does the interaction add information beyond the two state variables individually?
candidates.likely_canonical_source: Research Data Spine V0 fixed panel
candidates.pit_feasibility: All components use the same completed t boundary; future return is strictly later.
candidates.likely_historical_sample: Approximately four years after fixed warmup/tail.
candidates.shadow_deployability: One deterministic interaction and fixed regression forecast.
candidates.relation_to_existing_jigsaw: INCREMENTAL_INFORMATION_TEST; combines already-known state variables without claiming either component is novel.
candidates.relation_to_prior_failed_candidates: Not a parameter rescue; no threshold, sign flip, or alternate horizon.
candidates.strongest_falsifier: Interaction adds no material information or is non-identifiable under the fixed baseline.

candidates.mechanism: A one-hour range shock may proxy immediate repricing and predict continuation or reversal.
candidates.decision_time: After completed BTCUSDT hour at t.
candidates.baseline: Intercept plus prior BTCUSDT 24h return and RV24_t.
candidates.incremental_information_question: Does the bar range add information beyond return and volatility state?
candidates.likely_canonical_source: Research Data Spine V0 BTCUSDT partition
candidates.relation_to_existing_jigsaw: OTHER_EXPLICIT: generic range state; no current Jigsaw piece directly matches.
candidates.relation_to_prior_failed_candidates: Could become indicator-zoo adjacent without a stronger mechanism.
candidates.strongest_falsifier: No incremental effect after fixed controls.
candidates.rejection_reason: Lower structural novelty and weaker information gain than the five selected candidates; retained to preserve the search denominator.

candidates.mechanism: Concentration of trading volume across instruments may signal attention or risk transfer.
candidates.feature: VOLUME_CONCENTRATION_t = Herfindahl index of fixed-panel quote-volume shares.
candidates.decision_time: After completed panel hour at t.
candidates.incremental_information_question: Does panel volume concentration add information beyond focal return?
candidates.likely_canonical_source: Research Data Spine V0 fixed panel
candidates.pit_feasibility: Completed bar and positive total-volume denominator required.
candidates.relation_to_existing_jigsaw: NEW_PROPOSITION but volume-state semantics are not yet sufficiently qualified.
candidates.relation_to_prior_failed_candidates: Adjacent to JFP03 flow/volume but not a rescue; still risks source semantics ambiguity.
candidates.strongest_falsifier: Volume denominator or panel comparability fails, or no incremental effect.
candidates.rejection_reason: Panel-volume comparability and denominator semantics need a separate bounded qualification; defer rather than force.

candidates.mechanism: Crypto activity may exhibit stable UTC session structure.
candidates.feature: Fixed UTC hour-of-day categorical state for the decision bar.
candidates.incremental_information_question: Does a fixed session label add information beyond return state?
candidates.likely_canonical_source: Research Data Spine V0 BTCUSDT partition
candidates.rejection_reason: Calendar-state hypothesis is lower information value and too close to generic time-of-day mining for this batch.

candidates.short_name: Trend slope adds to return forecast
candidates.mechanism: A persistent market drift state may carry information about the next day.
candidates.feature: OLS slope of BTCUSDT log close over the prior 168 hourly bars.
candidates.incremental_information_question: Does a fixed weekly slope add information beyond recent return?
candidates.likely_canonical_source: Research Data Spine V0 BTCUSDT partition
candidates.relation_to_existing_jigsaw: CONDITIONAL_EXTENSION of prior H002/H003 trend families.
candidates.relation_to_prior_failed_candidates: Too close to graveyarded momentum and moving-average families; not a rescue.
candidates.strongest_falsifier: No incremental effect or duplicate family exposure.
candidates.rejection_reason: Substantive duplicate risk with prior trend/moving-average research and MEDIUM complexity; defer to a separately justified generation.

candidates.mechanism: Negative-return dominance in recent market movement may distinguish stress state from symmetric volatility.
candidates.feature: DOWNSIDE_SHARE_t = sum of prior 24h negative BTCUSDT return-square terms / sum of all prior 24h return-square terms; positive denominator required.
candidates.incremental_information_question: Does recent downside asymmetry add information beyond total recent volatility?
candidates.likely_canonical_source: Research Data Spine V0 BTCUSDT partition
candidates.relation_to_existing_jigsaw: DISTINCT_FEATURE; volatility outcome overlaps known evidence but feature proposition is new.
candidates.relation_to_prior_failed_candidates: No known exact failed frozen test.
candidates.strongest_falsifier: No incremental value beyond RV24 or insufficient positive denominators.
candidates.rejection_reason: Strong idea, but the selected batch already contains two volatility-state questions; retain as a transparent deferred alternative to limit correlated finalists.
